trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of approximately 145 degrees and a shallow depth relative to the lobe's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderate-frequency serrations are visible across the trailing edge, with pixel-amplitude increasing significantly toward the distal tips where biological growth disrupts the linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge exhibits a consistent concave sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of multi-colored (white, beige, and pink) pixels located on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes, indicating barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle encrustations on the distal margins of both fluke lobes; a distinct circular white pigmentation mark is visible on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, well-defined white ring-shaped marker on the upper surface of the right fluke lobe, approximately one-third of the distance from the tip to the notch.
